hero_subhead: Den 1880 is the perfect setting for your dream wedding, located in the heart of Uptown Waterloo. With its historic charm, unique character, and beautifully designed spaces, Den offers a truly unforgettable boutique backdrop for saying "I do."
band_intro: Den 1880 has partnered with some of the region's top vendors to offer an all-inclusive wedding experience. From catering and rentals to bar service and more, every detail is thoughtfully handled so you can enjoy a seamless, stress-free planning process and focus on the experience, not the logistics.
incl_intro: Inquire for our custom all-inclusive wedding packages, tailored to your celebration.
inquiry_intro: Tell us about your vision and we'll be in touch within one business day to put together a custom all-inclusive package.
inquiry_note: No commitment required, just a conversation.
